title: Tiger Gorilla
tagline: Swing, boost and sneak through twelve wrap-round jungle levels, catching parrots to feed the hungry babies back at the nest.
blurb: Swing, boost and sneak through twelve wrap-round jungle levels, catching parrots to feed the hungry babies back at the nest. Dodge the photographers' FLASH!, keep out of the crocodiles' pools and slip past the camera drones of the Waterfall Gorge. Feed every baby in all three zones and the family is safe!

quote.text: Snatching a parrot mid-air and plopping down at the nest for a YUM YUM

credits.name: Zippy Dee, Marjorie Plunkett and Grumpy Ken for INK & PAPER

shots.caption: Did you hear that?! Our hero drops right into the cameraman's line of fire.
